item.text: I’ll read the selected lyric, reconstruct the Urdu verses from its Roman text, and check that the two versions align stanza by stanza.

1
Zikar e Hussain Zikar-e-Khuda Aik Baat.
Iss Se Mila Ya Oss Ne Diya Aik Baat.
 Kashif Yeh Maan Kar Dar-e-Shabir Par Jhuka.
Rab Ki Atta Ya Iss Ki Atta Aik Baat Hai.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/zikar-e-hussain-zikar-e-khuda-aik-baat-tajpoints-3a4840d1b90501511345.md')
_, yaml, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].splitlines()
source = body.strip().splitlines()
assert len(roman) == len(source) == 5 and roman[0] == '  1' and source[0] == '۱'
assert all(line.startswith('  ') for line in roman)
assert [line.strip().casefold() for line in roman[1:]] == [line.casefold() for line in ['Zikar e Hussain Zikar-e-Khuda Aik Baat', 'Iss Se Mila Ya Oss Ne Diya Aik Baat', 'Kashif Yeh Maan Kar Dar-e-Shabir Par Jhuka', 'Rab Ki Atta Ya Iss Ki Atta Aik Baat Hai']]
assert 'noUrdu' not in yaml and 'direction: \"rtl\"' in yaml
print('Verified one stanza with four verses in each script and preserved Roman wording.')
PY"
